correctness.rationale: An inactive cut forces all entries crossing it to vanish, decomposing the matrix into principal blocks. Weight four permits exactly four active cuts of rank one or three consecutive active cuts with ranks \(1,2,1\). Exact finite-field counts give \(F_j=(q-1)(q^2+q-1)^{j-1}\) for \(1\le j\le4\) and \(H_3=q^2|\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb F_q)|\). Ordered run compositions and placements yield the formula for every prime-power \(q\) and all integers \(n\ge4\). Replayed independent source enumerations include a nonprime field and all \(2^{21}\) upper triangular binary matrices in dimension six, but the unbounded result relies on the written proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 primary paper establishes the first three nontrivial sphere coefficients and identifies higher-radius volumes as a natural open direction. Radius four is the next missing exact coefficient in every dimension \(n\ge4\). The formula supplies the packing volume needed for minimum-distance-nine flag-rank codes and improves the fixed-dimension large-field upper degree from ten to the exact degree seven. The extra term reflects a mathematically meaningful rank-two middle cut, not a numerical coincidence.
